//: Everything the published page says about itself, in one place. url: the site's absolute address (https://…, no trailing slash), used for canonical and og:url/og:image; leave empty until the domain is decided — those tags are then left out and og:image stays relative. SITE_URL in the environment overrides it at build time.
title: 具体詩
description: 入力された言葉を、音、文字の形、反復、欠落、語や文字のまとまりとして読み取り、一枚の詩へ変換する作品。同じ言葉からは、いつも同じ詩が生まれます。
